justifications.type_expressiveness: Distinct enum variants encode each failure mode (OutOfRange carrying the offending value, Empty, InvalidChar with the bad char, NotCanonical), with no stringly-typed data.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum with meaningfully distinct variants, no panics or unwraps in library code, and uses saturating_add defensively.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Narrow public surface, Debug/Clone/PartialEq/Eq derives, Display impl, and doc comments on every public item with std-conventional naming.
justifications.idiomaticity: Uses matches!, iterator-based table lookup, idiomatic enum error handling, and avoids unnecessary clones, though the round-trip re-encoding check is a slightly heavyweight canonicality test.
